title: 부동산등기특별조치법에따른대법원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Sending of Taxation Data) Where registration of a transfer of ownership based on a contract has been completed, the registration officer shall transmit the taxation data to the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the location of the relevant real estate, using an electronic data processing system as prescribed by the Supreme Court Regulations: Provided, That where it is not possible to transmit the taxation data through an electronic data processing system, or where any other ground prescribed by the Supreme Court Regulations exists, a copy of the application shall be transmitted.
